The decisive mistake was the wrong track. The manager's plan, which MarioKart8Deluxe_Expert carried forward at step 0, assumed the two-minute mark showed "Sweet Sweet Canyon". Nobody checked the GameGrumps video to confirm which track it was. Every later step researched Sweet Sweet Canyon, whose 150cc record at that time was around 1:48.5, not the correct 1:41.614. Step 3 also picked a record date without verifying it, but that error mattered less than searching the wrong track.
